messages:
Samir Rao: quick heads-up 1: we have inconsistent terminology for function/tool invocation across docs. some pages say `function_call`, some use `tool_call`, and the SDK snippets show `callTool` / `call_tool` depending on language. need canonical term + short migration note.
Priya Nair: agreed. this is causing confusion in the function-calling examples and the eval harness. users search for both terms and hit different pages.
Jordan Li: vote for `tool_call` as the canonical doc term. it's more general (covers tools, connectors, and functions).
Samir Rao: +1 to `tool_call` from me too. it's consistent with our "tool" concept in console.
Priya Nair: ok `tool_call` canonical in docs. For SDK snippets, show idiomatic casing per language and a mapping table: docs -> JS: `toolCall`, Python: `tool_call`, Go: `ToolCall`.
Jordan Li: please include tiny code examples so contributors copy-paste reliably: 
```
# Python (docs canonical: tool_call)
resp = client.generate(prompt="What's the weather?", tool_call={"name": "weather","args": {"zip": "94110"}})

// Node (camelCase in SDK)
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: "What's the weather?", toolCall: { name: 'weather', args: { zip: '94110' } } })
```
Samir Rao: also: glossary entry text suggestion: `tool_call (doc canonical) 1: a structured request from the model that invokes an external tool or function; SDKs show idiomatic casing. Link to tool security & observability page.`
docs-bot: Reminder: add a migration note and check PR template for "doc-term changes".
Priya Nair: migration checklist items I propose: 1) replace `function_call` -> `tool_call` in docs and snippets, 2) add a short paragraph in the style guide about canonical doc naming vs SDK casing, 3) add mapping table in migration notes, 4) run a grep across repo for the old term and file a follow-up for any missed examples.
Jordan Li: also update quickstart & the cookbooks (they're included in onboarding emails). I can scan the cookbooks for references.
Samir Rao: I'll open a docs PR for the glossary + style-guide patch. PR will include the mapping table and the three snippet language examples. PR link when ready.
Priya Nair: tiny UX nit: add a sentence in the glossary that we prefer explicit field names in examples (e.g., `tool_call.args`) to avoid magical positional args. keeps things clearer for new users.
Jordan Li: agree. also include a note about tone: short, code-first, and avoid anthropomorphic wording like "model calls a function"; prefer "the model requests a tool_call".
Samir Rao: tagging reviewers: @Priya, @Jordan. ETA EOD tomorrow for PR draft.
docs-bot: Auto-check: PR templates require a "breaking changes" checkbox if examples change public SDK param names.
Priya Nair: note for follow-up: ask SDK teams to add a non-breaking alias for a release or a clear migration passage in SDK changelogs.
Jordan Li: will ping SDK leads after PR lands.
Samir Rao: thanks all. I'll post PR link here once created and add a short changelog blurb.
Priya Nair: nice. :sparkles:
